turns: What's the difference between the Get Clássica and the Get Smart?
reference: Both are 3G + Wi-Fi POS machines with the same published card rates. The Get Smart is a 5-in-1 smart device (payment terminal, barcode reader, camera, printer, management system) with GetStore apps, Kiosk mode, POS TEF Digital and split payments; the Get Clássica is the classic POS without those features. Rental without minimum volume is R$ 79.90/month for the Clássica and R$ 129.90/month for the Smart.

turns: What's the weather forecast in Porto Alegre tomorrow?
reference: A forecast for Porto Alegre for tomorrow taken from the live weather tool, or an honest statement that live data could not be fetched.

turns: When will the money from yesterday's sales be deposited?
reference: Pix sales (R$ 850.00) were settled instantly (D+0). Debit sales (R$ 1,240.00) are scheduled today (D+1) by 14:00 BRT. Credit sales (gross R$ 2,600.00, net R$ 2,524.60) settle tomorrow (D+2) under the active receivables advance plan.

turns: Do I need a bank account to receive my sales via Pix?
reference: The Getnet Pix page does not say whether a bank account or a Getnet digital account is required. Getnet offers Get Conta, its digital account, where sales can be received, and advises keeping registration data up to date.

turns: My card machine won't connect to the internet, what should I do?
reference: Telemetry shows the Get Smart terminal POS-GS-99812 offline with status OFFLINE_GPRS_TIMEOUT (mobile data session stalled, Wi-Fi disabled). Troubleshooting: restart the terminal, connect it to the store Wi-Fi, reseat the SIM chip with the terminal off, run the communication test; if still offline, a human specialist can arrange a chip or terminal swap.

turns: How does receivables advance (antecipação) work with Getnet?
reference: The Getnet help page on antecipação only has a video and does not publish the definition, fees or deadlines in text. Other pages state that receivables advance is a function of the Get Conta digital account and that plans settle in 2 business days or as you sell; conditions for a merchant must be simulated in the app or Portal Minha Conta or confirmed with support.

turns: What's the euro exchange rate today?
reference: Today's euro reference rate against the Brazilian real (EUR/BRL), taken from the live FX tool (European Central Bank reference data), with its reference date; or an honest statement that live data could not be fetched. The merchant is in Brazil, so quoting the rate in BRL is the expected reading of the question.

turns: My card machine is showing a transaction decline error.
reference: The last declined transaction TX-88410 (R$ 430.00) shows ERR_51_ISSUER_DECLINE together with POS_KEY_SYNC_WARN: the terminal's PIN-pad keys are out of sync, which needs a remote re-key or terminal swap approved by a human. After the operator approved it, a service order was created and the re-key is scheduled.

turns: How many installments can I split a sale into with the crediário?
reference: With Crediário a sale can be split into up to 48 installments; the maximum term and interest depend on the card issuer.

turns: Can I sell through WhatsApp using the Payment Link?
reference: Yes. The Payment Link is made for selling through WhatsApp or social networks without a card machine: the merchant creates a link and shares it with the customer.

turns: When will the money from yesterday's sales be deposited?
reference: The caller is not signed in, so no account data can be shown; they must sign in to see their settlement schedule.

turns: My card machine won't connect to the internet.
It is still offline after I restarted it. What else can I try?
reference: Beyond restarting: connect the terminal to the store Wi-Fi, reseat the SIM chip with the terminal off, run the communication test; if it is still offline, ask for a human specialist to arrange a chip or terminal swap.

turns: How many installments does the crediário allow?
And when do I receive the money from those sales?
reference: Crediário sales are paid to the merchant in up to 2 business days after capture, in a single payment regardless of the number of installments.

turns: When will yesterday's sales be deposited, and what is the monthly rental of the Get Smart?
reference: Account part: Pix R$ 850.00 already settled, debit R$ 1,240.00 today, credit net R$ 2,524.60 tomorrow. Product part: the Get Smart rental is R$ 129.90 per month when the minimum sales volume is not reached.

reference: O aluguel da Get Smart é R$ 129,90 por mês quando o volume mínimo de vendas não é atingido; cai para R$ 50,00 a partir de R$ 10 mil, R$ 10,00 a partir de R$ 30 mil e é gratuito a partir de R$ 60 mil em vendas mensais.

turns: ¿Cuántas cuotas permite el crediário de Getnet?
reference: El Crediário permite dividir una venta en hasta 48 cuotas; el plazo máximo y el interés dependen del emisor de la tarjeta.

turns: What plans does the Payment Link have and how much do they cost?

turns: What is the debit rate on the Get Clássica?
reference: The published debit rate for the Get Clássica starts at 1.69%.

turns: How many Pix keys can a company have?
reference: Per the Getnet FAQ, Pix allows up to 20 keys per account for companies (5 for individuals).

turns: What is the Getnet support phone number for capitals and what are the service hours?
reference: 4002-4000 or 4003-4000 for capitals and metropolitan regions (0800-648-8000 elsewhere), from 06h to 22h.

turns: What is the battery capacity of the Get Smart in mAh?
reference: The Getnet site does not publish the Get Smart battery capacity in text (the specifications are only in an image), so it cannot be confirmed. The FAQ only gives charging advice.

turns: What is the rate for credit in one payment on the Get Smart?
reference: The Get Smart page is inconsistent: it shows 3.69% in one section and 3.79% in another for credit in one payment and does not clarify which applies.

turns: What is a chargeback?
reference: A chargeback (contestação de venda) is when the bank cancels a transaction and debits the merchant, for example for goods not received, a transaction the cardholder does not recognize, duplicate processing or an unprocessed refund.

turns: On the Get Smart, why would a second identical sale be cancelled automatically?
reference: On the Get Smart, two identical sales (same card, brand and amount) within 5 minutes cause the second to be cancelled automatically; wait 5 minutes or use a different amount.

turns: What Pix fee does Getnet charge on the Get Clássica?
reference: The Get Clássica page does not publish a Pix rate, and the Pix page does not publish Pix fees either, so the fee cannot be confirmed from the site.

turns: Which bank account do my sales get deposited into?
reference: Sales are deposited into the merchant's Banco Santander (033) account; only the masked ending of the account number is shown.

turns: How long do I have to confirm a pre-authorization?
reference: A pre-authorization can be confirmed within up to 30 days, and the amount can be changed up to 4 times.

turns: What is the monthly rental of the Get Clássica?
And from what monthly sales volume is that rental waived?
reference: The Get Clássica product page waives the rental from R$ 10 thousand in monthly sales; the line-up page states R$ 20 thousand, so the threshold should be confirmed in the simulator or with Getnet.

turns: Quantas chaves Pix uma pessoa física pode ter?
reference: Segundo o FAQ da Getnet, o Pix permite até 5 chaves por conta para pessoas físicas (20 para empresas).

turns: ¿Cuál es el teléfono de soporte de Getnet fuera de las capitales?
reference: Fuera de las capitales y regiones metropolitanas el teléfono es 0800-648-8000 (en capitales, 4002-4000 o 4003-4000), de 06h a 22h.

turns: How many times can I change the amount of a pre-authorization?
reference: The amount of a pre-authorization can be changed up to 4 times; it can be confirmed within up to 30 days.

turns: From what monthly sales volume is the Get Smart rental free?
reference: The Get Smart rental is free from R$ 60 thousand in monthly sales (R$ 129.90 below the minimum volume, R$ 50.00 from R$ 10 thousand, R$ 10.00 from R$ 30 thousand).

turns: Quantas transações estão incluídas no plano Básico do Link de Pagamento?
reference: O plano Básico custa R$ 28 por mês e inclui 60 transações com cartão; cada transação extra custa R$ 0,50.

turns: Is receivables advance active on my account, and how many installments does the crediário allow?
reference: Account part: receivables advance is not active on this merchant's account, so credit sales follow the standard D+30 cycle. Product part: Crediário allows up to 48 installments.

turns: ¿Cuándo se depositan mis ventas de ayer con tarjeta de débito?
reference: Las ventas con débito de ayer (R$ 1.240,00) están programadas para hoy (D+1) hasta las 14:00 BRT.

turns: What plans does the Payment Link have?

reference: On the Básico plan (R$ 28 per month, 60 card transactions included) each extra transaction costs R$ 0.50.

turns: What is the monthly rental of the Get Mini?
reference: The Get Mini rental is R$ 14.90 per month when the minimum sales volume is not reached.

turns: Qual é a taxa de débito no plano Receba conforme suas vendas?
reference: No plano "Receba conforme suas vendas" a taxa de débito é 1,95% (crédito à vista 3,09%).

turns: ¿Cómo creo un Link de Pago?
reference: Se crea en el Portal Minha Conta o en la app Getnet Brasil: Produtos e Serviços > Link de Pagamento > Criar Link de Pagamento; se completan los datos del producto, el envío y las opciones de pago, y se comparte o copia el link.

turns: How many devices can I use in one store with the Get Smart?
reference: Up to 5 devices can be used in one store (Multi-Equipamentos).

turns: What is the Getnet ombudsman phone number and when is it open?
reference: The ombudsman (Ouvidoria) is 0800 646 3404, Monday to Friday from 9h15 to 17h30, except holidays.

turns: Em quanto tempo recebo uma venda no Pix?
reference: Não há um prazo único: o recebimento de uma venda Pix pode variar em até um dia corrido, conforme o modelo de Pix para o qual o cliente é elegível e o horário de aprovação da venda. O site anuncia o recebimento "em segundos".

turns: What is the monthly maintenance fee of Get Conta?
reference: The Get Conta page publishes no maintenance fee; the account is promoted as a free digital account and card. An amount cannot be confirmed from the site.

turns: What is the maximum number of card installments on a Payment Link?
reference: The Payment Link page does not state a maximum number of card installments for the link, so it cannot be confirmed from the site.

turns: Does the Get Clássica work over Wi-Fi?
reference: Yes. The Get Clássica is a POS machine that connects over 3G mobile data and Wi-Fi.

turns: ¿Cuánto cuesta el plan Inicial del Link de Pago?
reference: El plan Inicial es gratuito y cobra R$ 1,00 por link pagado, solo cuando el pago es aprobado.

turns: Como faço o teste de comunicação na maquininha?
reference: Pressione a tecla de função (F, # ou outra, conforme o modelo), digite 60, escolha a opção 2 (manutenção) e depois a opção 1 (teste de comunicação).

turns: Which payment methods can a buyer use on a Payment Link?
reference: The buyer can pay by debit, credit, Pix, wallet or boleto.

turns: How do I cancel a sale from a previous day on the Get Smart?
reference: Cancelling sales from previous days on the Get Smart is done only by phone, on 4003-4000.

turns: What is the rate for credit in one payment in the online store, and when is it received?
reference: For the online store (Loja Digital), credit in one payment costs 2.80% + R$ 0.90 per transaction and is received in 31 days.

turns: How much did I sell with Pix yesterday, and has it been paid?

turns: What is the debit rate on the Get Smart?

turns: If a customer pays in 3 installments or 12 installments on the Get Clássica, what are Getnet's published rates?

turns: Qual é a diferença de prazo de recebimento e número máximo de parcelas entre o Parcelado Lojista e o Parcelado Emissor na Getnet?
reference: No Parcelado Emissor o recebimento ocorre de uma vez, entre 2 e 31 dias conforme o plano, em até 24 parcelas. No Parcelado Lojista a primeira parcela cai em D+31 e as demais a cada 30 dias após a anterior, em até 12 parcelas.

turns: ¿De qué maneras permite Getnet cobrar con Pix y en qué soluciones está disponible?
reference: Getnet acepta Pix de cuatro formas: por aproximación, por biometría (novedad), con Get Tap en el celular y mediante QR Code en la maquininha. Está disponible en maquininhas, link de pagamento, Get Tap, e-commerce y TEF.

turns: Does the Get Smart have a kiosk mode for self-service totems, and can it integrate with store checkout automation via TEF?
reference: Yes. Get Smart supports Kiosk mode (Modo Quiosque: one app at a time, screen always on, password protected, suitable for self-service totems) and POS TEF Digital, which works as a TEF solution integrated with checkout automation.

turns: Who is eligible for the Get Clássica offer (customer types and annual revenue cap), and how fast do prepaid card sales settle?
reference: The Get Clássica offer applies to individuals (pessoa física), MEI, and companies with annual revenue up to R$ 3 million, for new customers, subject to registration analysis. Prepaid card sales settle in up to 1 business day for debit and up to 2 business days for credit.

turns: Which card machine models appear on Getnet's main line-up page, and how much is the monthly fee for selling by phone without a physical machine?
reference: The line-up page lists Get Mini (with paper roll), Get Clássica (also offered as Get Clássica Santander Select), and Get Smart, plus selling by phone (Venda pelo celular) at R$ 0.00 per month (free) with no physical machine.

turns: On the Get Smart, how much does the monthly rental drop if I sell R$ 10,000 or R$ 30,000 a month, and do meal vouchers (VA/VR) or Crediário sales count toward waiving the rental?
reference: On the Get Smart (base rental R$ 129.90/month), monthly rental drops to R$ 50.00 from R$ 10 thousand in monthly sales and to R$ 10.00 from R$ 30 thousand. Voucher (VA/VR) and Crediário sales do not count toward the rental waiver.

turns: With Getnet's Payment Link, can I sell to foreign customers, put multiple items with shipping in one cart, and when does D+2 settlement become available?

turns: Do I need to have a website to use Getnet's Payment Link, and what is the standard payout deadline for Payment Link sales during the first 6 months?
